changes: Closed the INIT->INIT_CHECK uncommitted-metadata data-loss window (B-854c ClawCreek class). story_create now writes a clean-proof safe-init commit (new core/safe-init-commit.ts) to main HEAD inside the held main-write-lock, so INIT metadata is tracked/committed from birth and immune to a concurrent git clean -fd on the shared checkout. worktree.ts: INIT_CHECK bootstrap made idempotent (no duplicate init commit) + story_discard --purge tombstone fallback for buried init commits. story-metadata-protection.ts predicate broadened to unsafe=!tracked (catches the !ignored && !tracked INIT window) + doctor surface. New init-window-data-loss smoke (drives real story_create) + buried-tombstone assertion.
usage: No new command. Behavior change: after lattice story_create, the INIT metadata is committed on main (git log shows lattice: story <id> init) and survives a concurrent git clean -fd. lattice doctor now flags any uncommitted metadata leaf as a data-loss risk.
expectedOutcome: A story created in INIT no longer loses its metadata to a concurrent fleet git op; the init-window smoke passes and doctor flags uncommitted leaves.
actualTranscript: node init-window-data-loss-smoke.js -> ✓ INIT metadata survives concurrent git clean -fd; node review-pass-discard-smoke.js -> ✓ (HEAD reset + buried tombstone); lattice validate --story=B-02a6 -> 9/9 coverage, ALL PASS; CLI gate preflight all pass.
outcomeDiff: No difference — the window is closed (prevented, not merely recoverable). All 4 reviewers passed (concept/quality/test-coverage/behavior); F-001/F-002/F-003/F-004 resolved.
limitations: none — fully covered. Cost: one tiny metadata-only init commit per story_create (reversed on discard); accepted vs permanent data loss. Recovery of stories lost BEFORE this fix is out of scope (forward fix only).
pitfalls: The B-854c protection predicate had a blind spot: it only flagged ignored && !tracked, so the allowlisted-but-uncommitted INIT window (!ignored && !tracked) read as safe. A regression smoke MUST drive the REAL story_create — a self-contained smoke that hand-writes untracked files tests a git tautology, not the fix (caught in review). After fixing review findings, re-record verificationEvidence at the new HEAD or the freshness gate blocks (materialHash staleness).
